raw.query: SELECT w.requests, w.span_s / 86400.0 AS days, fc.provisioned_worker_seconds / st.provisioned_worker_seconds AS aggregate_ratio FROM provenance.windows w JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost fc ON fc.run_id = 'g4:FULL_enc_fc_rho15' JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost st ON st.run_id = 'g4:FULL_enc_static_C8' JOIN provenance.v_dim d_fc ON d_fc.run_id = fc.run_id AND d_fc.is_current JOIN provenance.v_dim d_st ON d_st.run_id = st.run_id AND d_st.is_current WHERE w.window_name = 'span_expctx'
raw.observed: 999,599 requests, 6.998 days, aggregate ratio 0.612x; disjoint fold ratios range from 0.187x to 1.098x
raw.claimed: 999,599 requests, 6.998 days, aggregate ratio 0.612x; 7 folds not fold-invariant
raw.evidence: Aggregate ratio of 0.612x matches database exactly; 7-day folds F1-F7 cost ratios are [0.652, 0.312, 0.465, 0.961, 0.187, 0.607, 1.098], proving fold-non-invariance.
